versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the remember-medical-notes skill for BlueColumn.
- Enables secure, user-authorized memory of health appointments, symptoms, and provider instructions.
- Emphasizes privacy: all notes are stored confidentially and only for authorized users.
- Supports logging appointments, tracking symptom history, and recalling key information for future visits.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*) for all operations.
